primary_claim: LLMs across a range of sizes and architectures (roughly 140M to 3B+ parameters) contain 'antonym heads': attention heads whose OV circuit maps a token to its semantic opposite, identifiable via characteristic eigenvalue patterns and confirmed by ablation
stated_future_work: Explore the eigenvectors associated with the high-magnitude eigenvalues more to verify the semantic-inversion hypothesis
Investigate what other top-scoring (non-maximal) heads are doing and how they compose
limitations_stated: Attempt to isolate and manipulate inverting eigen-directions directly did not give conclusive results
Did not investigate what other top-scoring heads are doing
Word pairs in the curated dataset are not perfectly independent, introducing some scoring error
quote: I find that LLMs ranging a variety of sizes and architectures contain antonym heads: attention heads which compute the semantic opposite of a token, mapping "hot" -> "cold", "true" -> "false", "north" -> "south", etc.
